section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) that investigated the indirect effects of overhearing family fat talk on mindful eating, mediated by body appreciation and functional body appreciation, among 333 undergraduate women from a southeastern public university. Participants completed an online survey. The study found an inverse association between family fat talk and mindful eating, body appreciation, and functional body appreciation, with functional body appreciation explaining the link between family fat talk and mindful eating, even after controlling for BMI.
